subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should OpenClaw accept the generic `channels.<kind>.accounts.<id>` account-scoped reload contract across channel plugins, with whole-channel fallbacks for default-account, channel-global, mixed, and unlisted-account changes?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the proposed generic contract changes a compatibility-sensitive gateway reload decision for every channel plugin with account maps.

options.title: Accept generic account-scoped reloads
options.body: Approve the current-base PR direction so account-only config edits restart only the affected account while preserving whole-channel safety fallbacks.

options.title: Require explicit plugin capability
options.body: Keep whole-channel restarts unless each channel plugin opts into account-scoped reload semantics through a declared capability.

options.title: Defer until channel-specific proof exists
options.body: Keep the issue open but delay merging a generic fix until more live transport proof exists beyond the current Mattermost and source-level evidence.

recommendation.title: Accept generic account-scoped reloads
recommendation.body: Approve the current-base PR direction so account-only config edits restart only the affected account while preserving whole-channel safety fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows the strongest ownership signal across the reload planner, reload handler, and channel manager surfaces.
